column1: # Provenance debt sorted by what moved beneath each document.
# NO STAMP IS ADVANCED BY THIS FILE. check_provenance is right that a stamp
# records a verification that happened; this only prices the debt, which
# commit 9bedb5e0). THE WITNESS BELOW IS THE WRONG ONE, and my own evidence was
# minutes BEFORE the GN158 pack at 01:21:49 - so it is not a GN158 export, and the
# "GN158 -> GN160" delta computed from it is not that delta. The census also records
# comment LENGTH only, with no prototype, calling convention or namespace, so it
# could not have witnessed what it was asked to.
# THE RIGHT WITNESS IS ALREADY IN THE STAMPS: the GFZFunctionAnnotationSnapshotV2
# files named by `snapshot_sha256`, which carry full per-function records. Against
# those the real deltas are 19 functions GN158->GN160 and 15 GN159->GN160, plate
# comment and tags only, embedded EXE identical - and `002F7380` and `00313A00`, two
# of "my 21", had already changed BEFORE GN158 was packed.
# NOT COVERED BY EITHER witness, and this is the part that matters: non-function
# symbols, the DTM, instruction-address comments, equates and reference overrides -
# which decompiler output depends on. The re-sort that supersedes the classes below
# quoting decompiler state, 20 genuine SNAPSHOT-DELTA (my TOUCHES-DELTA 32 was 12 too
# many). This file is kept because a superseded classification is evidence of how the
# question was got wrong, and deleting it would hide that.
# Measured across the three census exports: 0 entries added or removed, 0 names and 0
# body sizes differing in 38,161 rows; the whole moving surface is
#   TOUCHES-DELTA     cites one of the 21; owes a targeted read of that annotation
#   CENSUS-IDENTICAL  stale stamp, cites none of the 21; everything the FUNCTION
#                     CENSUS covers is provably unchanged beneath it. The census
#                     does not cover data labels, types, or comment TEXT - two
#                     comments of equal length compare equal here.
